gists: Kitchen chat with Hannah and Claire. Made cookies, got salad and milk from the shop (Claire had already got bread). Hannah gave me some of her egg and cheese pasta. Saved a couple of cookies under foil for Daniel. Taking dinner to the living room for the football later.

lines.name: Hannah Clarke
lines.say: Hey. Something smells good, what are you making? I'm doing pasta with whatever egg and veg we've got left, it's a bit of a fridge raid situation. Oh, and we're nearly out of bread, just so you know.
lines.do: drops bag by the door, opens the fridge and starts pulling out veg and eggs

lines.name: Chloe Bennett
lines.say: Hey! Oh, I'm just doing a batch of oat and raisin cookies, nothing fancy, they're nearly done actually. Fridge raid pasta sounds good though, ooh, is there enough egg for me to nab one later? Sorry, that's cheeky. And thanks for the bread heads up, I can pop to the shop in a bit, I need to go out anyway. How was your day?
lines.do: Peers into the oven, then wipes down the worktop while chatting

lines.name: Hannah Clarke
lines.say: Course you can have an egg, there's loads, I'll just do two for the pasta. Day was fine, bit of a slog, nothing dramatic. Oh, if you're going to the shop, could you grab a bag of salad too? I'll sort you out for it. Are the cookies for something or just a Friday thing?
lines.do: chops veg and puts a pan of water on to boil

lines.name: Chloe Bennett
lines.say: Yep, salad, no problem! Just a Friday thing really, I'm ahead on my coursework so I felt allowed. I'll leave a couple for you and Daniel for when he's back. Do you want anything else from the shop? Maybe I'll grab milk too, I think we're low.
lines.do: Takes the tray out of the oven and sets it on the hob to cool

lines.name: Hannah Clarke
lines.say: Milk would be great, yeah, I think we're down to a dribble. That's all though, thanks. Oh, and keep a cookie back for me, I'll be wanting one after this.
lines.do: tips the chopped veg into a pan with a bit of oil and cracks the eggs into a bowl

lines.name: Claire Hodgson
lines.do: comes in

lines.name: Chloe Bennett
lines.say: Oh hi Claire! We're doing a fridge raid pasta night, and I've just done cookies if you fancy one once they've cooled. I'm popping to the shop in a minute for bread, milk and salad, do you need anything while I'm there?
lines.do: Slides a cookie onto a plate and smiles at Claire, then reaches for her coat

lines.name: Claire Hodgson
lines.say: Hiya. Ooh, go on then, I'll have a cookie later, ta. I'm all right for the shop, I've just come from there actually. I've got bread, so you don't need to get that. There was plenty of milk at the back too, and the salad's probably worth a look at the yellow stickers by the chilled bit.
lines.do: Puts shopping bag on the worktop and starts unpacking the yellow-stickered bits

lines.name: Chloe Bennett
lines.say: Oh perfect, thanks Claire! Then I'll just nip out for the salad and a pint of milk, just in case. Yellow stickers, good shout. Back in ten, save me some pasta egg, Hannah!
lines.do: Puts the plate of cookies on the table, pulls on her coat and picks up her keys

lines.name: Hannah Clarke
lines.say: Oh, nice one Claire, saved us a trip really. Chloe, don't forget the egg thing, I'll keep some back. Claire, how was the shop, was it rammed? I always go on a Friday and regret it.
lines.do: stirs the veg in the pan, then turns the heat down a bit and tips pasta into the boiling water

lines.name: Claire Hodgson
lines.say: Pretty busy, yeah, the after-work lot were all in. Queue took a few minutes but it was fine. I always go Friday too, bad habit. Smells good, Hannah, what's going in the pasta?
lines.do: unpacks the shopping, puts the milk and yellow-stickered bits in the fridge

lines.name: Hannah Clarke
lines.say: Just veg and egg, really. Whatever's left of the courgette and a bit of onion, and I'm going to beat the eggs with some cheese and tip it through at the end, sort of carbonara-ish. Could go horribly, we'll see. Do you want some? There's plenty of pasta.
lines.do: stirs the veg, glances at the pasta water

lines.name: Claire Hodgson
lines.say: Oh, go on then, just a small bit, ta. I've only got a ready meal and some veg to do, so that saves me. I'll put the kettle on, do you want a tea?
lines.do: Finishes unpacking the shopping and flicks the kettle on

lines.name: Hannah Clarke
lines.say: Yes please, tea would be lovely, ta. Just a small bit of pasta then, it's nearly there. Oh, and Chloe's cookies are on the table if you fancy one while you wait.
lines.do: drains the pasta, then beats the cheese into the eggs

lines.name: Chloe Bennett
lines.do: comes in

lines.name: Claire Hodgson
lines.say: That was quick, Chloe. Did you get the salad? Kettle's just boiled, Hannah, one tea coming up.
lines.do: Gets mugs out, makes two teas, takes a cookie from the table

lines.name: Hannah Clarke
lines.say: Ha, nice, you were quick. Did they have any salad left? Oh, and thanks Claire, that's perfect. Right, egg and cheese going in now, so stand back, this is the risky bit.
lines.do: takes the tea, tips the drained pasta into the veg pan, takes it off the heat and stirs the egg and cheese through

lines.name: Chloe Bennett
lines.say: Yep, got the salad, they had a few yellow-stickered ones left, so good shout Claire. And milk, loads at the back like you said. Ooh Hannah, that looks properly good, not horrible at all! Can I nab my egg bit now or shall I wait till it's plated? Sorry, I'm hovering.
lines.do: Takes coat off, puts salad and milk in the fridge, then hovers by the hob with a plate

lines.name: Claire Hodgson
lines.say: Ha, go on Chloe, she's not going to stop you. Cookie's lovely by the way. I'll take my tea through in a bit, got a ready meal to stick in.
lines.do: sips tea, pulls the ready meal out of the fridge and checks the label

lines.name: Hannah Clarke
lines.say: Go on Chloe, help yourself, there's loads. Take the egg-ier bit from the top, that's where the cheese ended up. Claire, I'll have my tea in a sec, I'm just plating up. Did you want yours in a bowl or on a plate?
lines.do: stirs the pasta once more, then starts dishing it into bowls

lines.name: Chloe Bennett
lines.say: Ooh thanks Hannah, you're a star. Just a little bit of the egg-ier bit then, I don't want to take your share! Claire, I'll have my plate in the living room too if you're going through, I've got the football on later. Want me to put a couple of cookies aside for Daniel?
lines.do: Holds plate out to Hannah, then covers the cookie plate with foil

lines.name: Claire Hodgson
lines.say: Yeah, pop a couple aside for Daniel, he'll be glad of them. Hannah, a bowl's fine, ta. Small bit, mind. I'll stick my ready meal in and take it all through.
lines.do: Puts the ready meal in the oven and picks up her tea

lines.name: Hannah Clarke
lines.say: Bowl it is, small bit coming up. Here you go, Claire. Chloe, there's plenty if you want to go back for more. I'll bring mine through in a minute, I'm just going to wipe the hob before it sets like cement.
lines.do: dishes a small bowl of pasta and hands it to Claire, then fills her own bowl

lines.name: Chloe Bennett
lines.say: Lovely, thanks Hannah. Right, I'll take this through and put the cookies for Daniel on the side with the foil on. Claire, shout if you want the telly on something else, I'm only doing the football later. Sorry, I'll shut up and eat now!
lines.do: Takes her plate of pasta and the salad, puts the foil-covered cookies for Daniel on the worktop, heads to the living room

lines.name: Claire Hodgson
lines.say: Right, I'll take this through then. Hannah, your tea's on the side by the kettle.
lines.do: Picks up pasta bowl and tea, leaves the oven on for the ready meal, heads to the living room

lines.name: Hannah Clarke
lines.say: Cheers Claire. Right, wipe the hob, then I'll bring mine through.
lines.do: wipes the hob down, puts the pan in the sink, picks up her bowl and tea
